personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT with 3 Editorial structure
personality_one_liner: An authentic, warm, and welcoming country line dance library that feels like weathered leather, barn wood, and desert sunsets.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Allow the UI to breathe. Avoid dense lists. Let elements feel grounded and slightly tactile like pages in a journal.

dont's: No blur/glass effects. Use solid surfaceSecondary or brandTertiary with low opacity to maintain the tactile, earthy, non-digital feel.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A welcoming front door to the venue, inviting all ages to jump in and dance.

states.loading: Centered spinner matching the brandPrimary color.
states.empty: N/A - Home is static content and quick links.
states.error: Failed to load venue updates. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Stompin Ground Yuma' wordmark in Fraunces. Hero section featuring the cowboy boots image with a warm gradient scrim and welcome text overlaid. Below the hero: a clean grid or stacked cards for 'New Dances Added', 'Venue Info' (Yuma, AZ), and a prominent CTA to 'Start Browsing'. Use tactile, slightly offset spacing.

screens.name: Library (Dances)
screens.purpose: The core searchable and filterable database of line dances.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty dance floor or boots, 'No dances found for this filter. Try clearing your search.'
states.error: Failed to load dances. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top with a horizontal scrollable row of pill-shaped filter chips (All, Beginner, Improver, Intermediate, Advanced). Below, a vertical scrolling list of dance cards. Each card displays: Title (Fraunces), Choreographer (small text), Song Name, and a Difficulty badge (color-coded). Include a subtle chevron on the right. Avoid heavy shadows; use a 1px border or solid surfaceSecondary background for cards.

screens.name: Dance Detail
screens.purpose: All the info a dancer needs to learn the routine, including video and personal tracking.
screens.layout: Full-bleed image/video thumbnail at the top with a gradient scrim and a large Play icon. Below the media: Title, Choreographer, Song Info, BPM. A distinct section below for 'My Notes & Rating' with interactive star ratings. Fixed sticky CTA container at the bottom over the scroll view with two buttons: 'Add to Wishlist' (Secondary) and 'Mark Completed' (Primary).

screens.name: My Dances
screens.purpose: Personal tracking of completed dances and wishlist.

states.empty: A stylized hat icon with 'You haven\'t added any dances yet. Head to the Library to find your next challenge!'

screens.layout: Large title 'My Tracker'. A segmented control (Completed | Wishlist) using surfaceTertiary and brandPrimary for the active indicator. The list mirrors the Library layout but adds the user's star rating and quick-action swipe to remove or move between lists.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User stats, auth management, and admin access point.
screens.layout: Profile header with an avatar (or initials) over the brown leather texture banner. A stats row showing 'Dances Completed' and 'Wishlist Size' in large numbers. Below, settings rows in surfaceSecondary containers with Phosphor icons on the left. Includes Google Login / Email Auth entry points and an 'Admin Tools' section if the user has the correct role.

library_banner.alt: Group of people dancing at a country party

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No blues except the brandSecondary (Denim Blue) and no purples. Keep the UI feeling warm and earthy.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or heavy drop shadows. This app relies on the 'Hand-Drawn / Journal' tactile style. Use subtle 1px borders (#DCD3C6) or solid surfaceSecondary blocks for separation.
Implement a mandatory gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) on the 'venue_hero' and 'library_banner' background images so that the text layered over them is legible.
Make sure the 'Add to Wishlist' / 'Mark Completed' CTA buttons in the Dance Detail screen are sticky and fixed at the bottom over the scroll view, easily accessible by the thumb.
Format difficulty badges with distinct colors (e.g., Beginner=success green, Intermediate=warning orange, Advanced=error red, Improver=brandSecondary blue).
For user auth, include Google Login as well as Email/Password forms on the Auth screen, matching the rustic UI design.
